annotations.title: Autonomous Agent Action-Trace Loop & Token-Burn Circuit Breaker

description: Analyzes an agent's recent tool-call trace to detect identical retry spins, A/B state oscillation, and runaway token burn. Use when monitoring multi-step agent execution loops to decide whether to continue or halt and escalate; for inspecting a single command payload for security threats before execution, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'action_trace_json' ('sensitivity' defaults to 'strict_2_repeats'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

action_trace_json.description: JSON-serialized array of recent agent actions (e.g. '[{"tool":"search","status":"err"}]').

sensitivity.description: Cycle detection threshold; defaults to 'standard_3_repeats' when omitted.

name: detect_agent_action_loop

estimated_tokens_saved.description: Projected token burn prevented by tripping the circuit breaker.

loop_detected.description: True if a repetitive retry spin or A/B oscillation cycle is active.
